value.note: HOST-NATIVE MAME nws3260 (drawshm 1120x780 mono LCD, ctlsock keys via generated keymap, pointer via ctlsock MOVEA open-loop at 1:1). No save-state in the driver: reset=relaunch cold-boots the installed disk (~90 s to sxdm). root / no password; xterm via sxsession Application menu (press-and-hold).

labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE: MAME 0.289 nws3260 runs on the host, no QEMU/QMP, no exec channel. Frames drawshm->shm, keys ctlsock + newsos.keymap, pointer ctlsock MOVEA (open-loop, X server -a 1 -t 1 so 1 count = 1 px). Launcher stations/mame-native/x11-runtime.sh; reset=relaunch (driver has no save state) power-cycles: Automatic Boot DIP + /fastboot -> sxdm login in ~90 s. Disk = a writable raw image (persists across relaunches; reset=relaunch is a power-cycle, fsck -p repairs any unclean stop). DARK LAUNCH: listing=hidden until the operator eyeballs it.

museum.blurb: Sony's NEWS workstations were Japan's answer to Sun: BSD Unix on MIPS with an X11 desktop, sold to universities and research labs across Japan. The NWS-3260 was the portable of the line — a 1120x780 monochrome LCD folded over an R3000.
museum.notes: Host-native MAME 0.289 nws3260 (news_r3k.cpp, working driver with a real LCD framebuffer) — chosen over the nws5000x the candidate doc first named, which has no local framebuffer. NEWS-OS 4.1R from the nwf_672rb MO kit (the 4.2.1aRD CD is NWS-5000-only). Sourced media and ROMs recorded in docs/guests/newsos.md.

network.note: MAME nws3260 with no TAP in the rig; NEWS-OS installed without the network package (docs/guests/newsos.md)

listing.reason: Dark launch: NEWS-OS 4.1R is being installed on camera at /os/newsos; the row is hidden from the grid and the hall until the installed disk boots to sxdm and the operator has eyeballed it.

reset.fixture: NEWS-OS 4.1R on the NWS-3260 LCD (1120x780 mono) at the sxdm login (NEWS logo, 'NEWS-OS Release 4.1R (localhost)'); relaunch power-cycles the machine (no save state in the driver): Automatic Boot DIP + /fastboot -> login in ~90 s from a writable raw disk image (fsck -p repairs any unclean stop). Keyboard PASS = ROM monitor, installer TUI and xterm answered typed text over ctlsock; mouse PASS = MOVEP/DOWN1/UP1 opened the sxsession Application menu and launched xterm, 1:1 after Xservers -a 1 -t 1 — all framebuffer-proven 2026-08-18. Operator eyeball pending.
